text:
Sofia: FRA gateway held our inbound truck 3AP: HS reclass. AWB 987-65432100. PO RDW-74200. Carrier suggests split: air 6x H100, sea rest. Need decision: air (~€13,200) or clear (~3d).

Marco (AtlasShip): Confirmed hold. Commodity description mismatch. Can pull 6 SNs for air (ETA 36-48h) + sea for remaining (ETA 9-12d). Expedited est €13,200 incl urgent brokerage. We can reduce to €8,200 with PO amendment + credit on next PO.

Priya: Finance won't greenlight €13k. Can you firm €8k? Need contiguous SNs and firmware parity for tagging.

Marco (AtlasShip): Air SNs contiguous: H100-PL-10001..10006. Sea: H100-PL-10007..10020. Firmware v3.2.1 on all. Firm best price €8,200 if amendment executed now.

Devon: Ops: if we accept split, request FRA depot QC hold. Do not auto-provision until depot photos + POST pass. Open provisional RMA for DOA.

ops-bot: Created task `task-rdw-74200-depot-qc` assigned to @Devon. Checklist: inbound photos, serial reconciliation, 30m burn-in, dmesg, power POST.

Kira: Infra note: rack onboarding in FRA-1 tight. If air arrives in 48h expect ~72h for physical install + 24h integration tests. Tag cost-center INFRA-EDGE.

Priya: Approved up to €8,200 with INFRA-EDGE coding. Send amendment to procurement@redwood.ai.

Marco (AtlasShip): Amendment sent to Sofia. Proforma attached. AWB ABF987654321 once dispatched. Precreating RMA: RMA-RDW-26-045. Prepaid return labels attached.

Theo: I'll reserve 3U rack in FRA-1 bay-4 and pre-stage rails/PDUs. Expect ~2h/unit to mount. Ping when depot photos uploaded.

Sofia: Marco : please also send customs broker contact + signed commercial invoice PDF to customs@redwood.ai and billing. Need to avoid repeat hold. Carrier pickup photos requested.

Marco (AtlasShip): Will send broker contact + invoice in 15m and attach pickup photos to AWB email.

Devon: Pre-hold logs from provisioner before hold:
```
$ kubectl -n infra logs provisioner-rc | tail -n 8
2026-04-02T14:03:12Z provisioner: reconcile complete
2026-04-02T14:03:16Z inventory: inbound 0 -> pending 1
2026-04-02T14:03:20Z health: routing-latency 3ms, nodes nominal
```
No anomalies.

Sofia: Ok, proceeding with amendment flow. Will reopen thread when depot QC uploads photos.

Priya: Thanks all.
